summary: Each shard of the fractal-web execution job signs its own result in shadow, and the note job publishes and shadow-verifies it as the fractal-web lane

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change; CI configuration only.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. Nothing reads the fractal-web notes to skip a check; no policy names the lane.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. Required checks keep their names and outcomes; every added step is fail-soft and runs after the lane's own step.

recovery.detail: Revert this change; notes already published stay valid and are only accepted through the base-commit key list.
